application: commerce consultation and human handoff workbench

separation_rules.admin_has_no_approval: admin must not gain approval:decide through its role
separation_rules.admin_has_no_consult: admin must not act as a consulting user
separation_rules.self_approval: approver actor id must differ from the run owner actor id
separation_rules.approval_channel: approver authenticates separately from the owner session

identity_rules.actor_id: stable user:<uuid>; never a role name

session_cookie.name: fh_identity
session_cookie.secure: required when the deployment serves HTTPS

object_checks.rule: bound owner equals actor id; sdk re-checks session.actor_id
same tenant and (requester is actor and ticket:read_own) or ticket:read_scope
resource present in server-side scope and role holds read/draft/publish
distinct actor, approval:decide, identical scope, current state

required_negative_cases: user A reads user B session
user A submits into user B session
disabled user replays a previous cookie
body tries to assert actor, roles or tenant
